newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada new housing price index flat in February.
newsitem.headline: Canada new housing price index flat in February.

text.p: Canada's new housing price index showed no change in February 1997 compared to February 1996, staying at 132.4 (base 1986), Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
Index Feb yr pct month pct
The index measures changes of contractors' selling prices of new residential houses.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast a 0.2 percent rise in the annual index.
Statistics Canada said this is the first time since July 1994 that the annual change has not been negative.

The federal agency said the improvement of housing markets in recent months has been attributable to higher consumer confidence coupled with favorable interest rates. But competition has moderated price increases in a number of surveyed cities despite reported rises in construction costs in these cities.
